layers.title: Truck Routes
layers.notes:
All truck traffic through the City of Placentia must comply with the size and weight requirements under the Division 15, Chapter 5, Article 6 of the California Vehicle Code (CVC). Transportation permits are required on all vehicles exceeding the limits of a legal load, as defined by the CVC.
Prior to obtaining a Transportation permit, the permittee shall check overhead utilities such as (Edison, AT&T, Time Warner, etc.) for adequate vertical clearance prior to movement of any large and wide load

layers.title: Indoor Radon Potential Zones
layers.notes:
This layer is presenting the portions of the city area where homes are more likely to have indoor-air radon concentrations exceeding the U.S EPA recommended radon active level of 4.0 picocuries per liter. This layer will assist in identifying areas where indoor-radon testing should be encouraged and public awareness programs may be beneficial.
Data from California State Geoportal and provided by California Department of Conservation_July 2016
